title: Apple banned Alex Jones and Infowars from its podcast directory. But Apple's App Store has different rules, and you can still download the Infowars app (AAPL)
text: ▶ Apple Wipes Out Nearly All Of Infowars Podcasts From iTunes 00:50 Alex Jones/YouTube Apple has scrubbed nearly all of Alex Jones' Infowars podcasts from iTunes and its Podcast app. The company said it does not "tolerate hate speech," adding that creators that violate its guidelines will be punished.
